raise_justifications.backend/utils/apps.py: app_can_persona_chat capability gate (checks App.capabilities for the additive 'persona_chat' capability) plus persona capability helpers backing the AI Clone user-account persona-chat endpoint (PR #8822); supersedes the #10074 model-availability raise.
raise_justifications.backend/utils/other/storage.py: delete_app_logo now requires an exact app-logo bucket prefix (startswith) so a foreign URL embedding the prefix later cannot delete an unrelated object on this deletion path (David review on #9873).
raise_justifications.backend/utils/conversations/process_conv: extract_memories returns a ConversationMemoryExtractionResult emitted once as the Conversation Memories Extracted product-analytics event after durable persistence, closing the validated macOS recording-to-memory observability gap (SCA-99); persistence behaviour is unchanged.
raise_justifications.backend/utils/sync/pipeline.py: Speech-free segments are now recorded as valid silence beside the existing outcome recorders rather than as retryable failures (#10544), so a recording of pure noise stops finalizing the job failed and re-uploading forever; the helper and its billing guard are colocated with the segment-outcome recording they mirror.
